description: Agent Migration: submit whether one move can be reversed, as its return path, the steps that cannot be undone, or both: how the plan presents the move (reversible or one way), whether a way back to the source is written down, how the agent moves back, how long the way back stays open after cutover, what returning costs and whether the return has been rehearsed; and each step that cannot be undone once it happens (source data deleted, a name or handle released, funds spent, a key revoked, the source account closed, a contract ended or other) with how many days after cutover it happens and whether the plan marks it as permanent. The signed report gives the return path, its window in days with the steps that close it early, and every permanent step with its status, and names a one-way door presented as reversible: a move presented as reversible with no written way back, and a permanent step such as deleting the source data that happens before the return window closes; then an honest one-way move, a way back with no deadline, no stated cost or no rehearsal, and permanent steps the plan does not mark, with the fix for each. The general rollback path for one action’s external effects is wever_rollback-path-check, and halting a running agent system is wever_kill-switch-check. Verdict return_path_closed, return_path_gaps, return_path_unverified or return_path_open. POST /api/migration-return-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write, and no data is moved. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-migration-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-migration/.

irreversible.description: Each step of the move that cannot be undone once it happens.

days_after_cutover.description: Days after cutover it happens; 0 for at cutover.

item.description: A step that cannot be undone, such as deleting the source account.

kind.description: Source data deleted, a name or handle released, funds spent, a key revoked, an account closed, a contract ended or other.

marked_permanent.description: The plan marks it as permanent.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

cost.description: What returning costs, such as 40 USDC or a day of downtime.

exists.description: A way back to the source is written down.

method.description: How the agent moves back, such as restoring the source account from the export.

presented_as.description: How the plan presents the move: reversible or one way.

window.description: How long the way back stays open after cutover, such as 14 days.

name: wever_migration-return-check
title: Migration return check
